chapter: Blue Devils, Moten and the Reno Club
title: Second piano with Moten and Bus Moten's accordion
summary: Basie corrects the claim of a third piano: he played second piano, and Bus Moten played accordion.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Joined Benny. "I played third piano in that band." Is it third or second? Second. Third? Jazz bands didn't have 3 pianos.
They didn't. What band had 3 pianos? Hardly any bands had two.
Jesus. So you played second piano in that band. "Benny, of course, was the big man at the keys and his brother Bust --" Is that what you called him, Bust? -- "played piano accordion."
Not piano, but accordion. Not piano. It was an accordion.
There's an accordion called piano accordion.
All right, there was no third piano, that's interesting. Oh, yeah, we were on the piano accordion.
